title: Pulse CLI project file
description: The project file .pulse-cli.json: profiles a repository shares with its team, read by the Pulse CLI and Pulse for VS Code. It names engines, never credentials. The CLI also refuses a defaultProfile that is not one of the file's profiles, a rule JSON Schema cannot express.

$schema.description: The URL or path of this schema, so that your editor checks the file. The CLI keeps it when it writes the file.

defaultProfile.description: The profile commands use inside the repository when none is named. Blank means none; otherwise it names one of the profiles of this file.

profiles.description: The profiles by name: letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-", starting with a letter or digit.

url.description: The REST API root, e.g. http://localhost:8080/engine-rest: an http or https URL without credentials, query or fragment (checked when the profile is used).

cockpitUrl.description: The engine's web app, for links only, e.g. http://localhost:8080/operaton/app/cockpit/default/: an http or https URL without credentials, query or fragment (checked when the profile is used).

engine.description: The name of a process engine (/engine/{name}); without it the default engine.

flavor.description: The product behind the URL; camunda7 when absent. Pulse for VS Code reads camunda8 profiles; the CLI refuses one when it is used.

output.description: The output format; without it a table on a terminal, JSON otherwise.

headers.description: Extra request headers. A project file stores no secret header: credentials, cookies and names containing token, secret, password or api-key go into PULSE_CLI_HEADERS or your own config file.

anyOf.description: Connection management headers the HTTP client sets itself.

additionalProperties.description: An ISO-8859-1 (Latin-1) value without control characters but tab.

readOnly.description: true refuses every write through this profile.

auth.description: How the CLI authenticates. Without type a username selects Basic auth; OAuth needs type oauth. Credentials come from the environment, an OAuth login or a profile of the same name in your own config file.

type.description: none, basic, oauth or bearer (checked when the profile is used).

issuer.description: The OAuth issuer, discovered unless both endpoints are set.

authorizationEndpoint.description: The OAuth authorization endpoint; only together with tokenEndpoint.

tokenEndpoint.description: The OAuth token endpoint; only together with authorizationEndpoint, or alone with type clientCredentials.

scopes.description: The OAuth scopes, each listed once; openid and offline_access when absent.

redirectPort.description: The port of the login callback; 0 for any free port.

oauthType.description: OAuth settings need type oauth (or none, which switches them off).

credential.description: A project file is shared and names no credentials, neither secrets nor the variables that hold them: they come from the environment (PULSE_CLI_TOKEN, PULSE_CLI_TOKEN_COMMAND, PULSE_CLI_PASSWORD, PULSE_CLI_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET) or a profile of the same name in your own config file.
